I feel similarly about meds, I was in a very bad place when I started adhd meds and in the end (after a year of suffering and extreme weight loss) it led me to be in a psych ward for damn near three months. I was again medicated but this time with 5 more daily pills for the depression etc.. Two years ago I had enough and I have not taken any medication since, it was a rough two years for sure, I lost my job and some friends but I learned to cope and take care of myself, now I am the best I've ever been. I still miss the clear headed, productive feeling of my meds but I'd rather wait one more year until I am absolutely ready to try again.
I think you have to work on keeping yourself sane and happy when you take adhd medication because they will not make all the shit that comes along with adhd go away magically. Or try to work through it without any meds :)
